# Senegal

The wealth gradients this library holds for Senegal: first the values to give OG-Core, then the measurements behind them. New to the terms? See the [glossary](../glossary.md).

## What to use in OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Tilt | From |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | **by age**, table below (fertility tilt −0.76 plus the [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md)) | DHS 2023 |
| `infmort_gradient` | **−0.79** | DHS 2023 |
| `mort_gradient` | **−0.34** (ages 15–60) | census 2002, own measurement |
| `imm_pctiles` | not covered by this library | — |

Every value is a **tilt** ([what that is](../glossary.md#tilt)). Convert it before passing it to OG-Core: `tilt / (100 × (1 − p))`, with p OG-Core's own rate at that age ([how](../methods/ogcore-units.md)).

**Fertility tilt by mother's age** (for `fert_gradient`; ages under 15 take the 15–19 value, 50 and over the 45–49 value):

| 15–19 | 20–24 | 25–29 | 30–34 | 35–39 | 40–44 | 45–49 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −1.54 | −0.86 | −0.55 | −0.43 | −0.67 | −1.15 | −1.74 |

## Where these numbers come from

| Measure | Survey | Tilt | Poorest ÷ richest tenth | Poorest fifth → richest fifth |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| Infant deaths per 1,000 births (IMR) | 2023 | **−0.79** | 1.6× | 40 · 40 · 32 · 21 · 25 |
| Under-5 deaths per 1,000 births (U5MR) | 2023 | **−0.88** | 1.7× | 54 · 50 · 42 · 26 · 31 |
